title: Geekvape Wenax M1 Replacement Pods - 4 Pack
description: The Geekvape Wenax M1 is an incredibly lightweight and portable vape device that’s ideal for beginners or any adult vaper who just wants a discreet and convenient pod kit to carry anywhere. These replacement pods can contain 2ml of your favourite e-liquid and are simple to refill thanks to the handy side-fill port. With a fixed coil, these pods provide a flavoursome MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape experience when paired with the GeekVape Wenax M1 pod kit. These 2ml pods are best used with nic salt , 50/50 and classic High-PG e-liquids.
